panels.title: Honeypot Overview — haproxy front (real attacker IPs, 80/20 cowrie/beelzebub split)
Unique Attacker IPs (24h)
panels.description: Distinct src_ip values over the range, excluding pod-CIDR (10.244.x.x) kubelet/health-probe noise.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT uniqExactIf(extract(Body, '^([0-9.]+):[0-9]+ '), extract(Body, '^([0-9.]+):[0-9]+ ') != '') AS "Unique IPs"
FROM default.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(TimestampTime)
  AND LogAttributes['namespace'] = 'honeypot' AND LogAttributes['container'] = 'haproxy'

panels.title: Total Connections
panels.description: Distinct src_ip values over the range, excluding pod-CIDR (10.244.x.x) kubelet/health-probe noise.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT countIf(extract(Body, '^([0-9.]+):[0-9]+ ') != '') AS "Connections"
FROM default.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(TimestampTime)
  AND LogAttributes['namespace'] = 'honeypot' AND LogAttributes['container'] = 'haproxy'

panels.title: Cowrie hits (80%)
panels.description: Distinct src_ip values over the range, excluding pod-CIDR (10.244.x.x) kubelet/health-probe noise. NOTE: 80/20 is the haproxy WEIGHT, which assigns new unique source IPs -- it is NOT the observed connection share. `stick on src` pins each attacker IP to one honeypot, so a single high-volume attacker skews the counts hard: over one 6h window the real split was beelzebub 1554 / cowrie 366 (81/19) while the weights were 50/50, because one IP (109.160.32.38) contributed 1439 of those. Compare "Unique Attacker IPs" for the weighted behaviour.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT countIf(extract(Body, '/(cowrie|beelzebub) ') = 'cowrie') AS "Cowrie"
FROM default.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(TimestampTime)
  AND LogAttributes['namespace'] = 'honeypot' AND LogAttributes['container'] = 'haproxy'

panels.title: Beelzebub hits (20%)
panels.description: Distinct src_ip values over the range, excluding pod-CIDR (10.244.x.x) kubelet/health-probe noise. NOTE: 80/20 is the haproxy WEIGHT, which assigns new unique source IPs -- it is NOT the observed connection share. `stick on src` pins each attacker IP to one honeypot, so a single high-volume attacker skews the counts hard: over one 6h window the real split was beelzebub 1554 / cowrie 366 (81/19) while the weights were 50/50, because one IP (109.160.32.38) contributed 1439 of those. Compare "Unique Attacker IPs" for the weighted behaviour.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT countIf(extract(Body, '/(cowrie|beelzebub) ') = 'beelzebub') AS "Beelzebub"
FROM default.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(TimestampTime)
  AND LogAttributes['namespace'] = 'honeypot' AND LogAttributes['container'] = 'haproxy'

panels.title: Backend Split (cowrie vs beelzebub)
panels.description: Distribution of Cowrie eventid types over the range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT extract(Body, '/(cowrie|beelzebub) ') AS backend, count() AS connections
FROM default.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(TimestampTime)
  AND LogAttributes['namespace'] = 'honeypot' AND LogAttributes['container'] = 'haproxy' AND extract(Body, '/(cowrie|beelzebub) ') != ''
GROUP BY backend ORDER BY connections DESC

panels.title: Top Attacker IPs (all honeypots)
panels.description: Most active source IPs over the range (all events), excluding pod-CIDR 10.244.x.x health-probe noise.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT extract(Body, '^([0-9.]+):[0-9]+ ') AS "Source IP", count() AS Connections,
  uniqExact(extract(Body, '/(cowrie|beelzebub) ')) AS Backends, max(TimestampTime) AS "Last seen"
FROM default.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(TimestampTime)
  AND LogAttributes['namespace'] = 'honeypot' AND LogAttributes['container'] = 'haproxy' AND extract(Body, '^([0-9.]+):[0-9]+ ') != ''
GROUP BY "Source IP" ORDER BY Connections DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Connections Over Time (by backend)
panels.description: Rate of new honeypot sessions (cowrie.session.connect).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(TimestampTime) AS time, extract(Body, '/(cowrie|beelzebub) ') AS backend, count() AS connections
FROM default.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(TimestampTime)
  AND LogAttributes['namespace'] = 'honeypot' AND LogAttributes['container'] = 'haproxy' AND extract(Body, '/(cowrie|beelzebub) ') != ''
GROUP BY time, backend ORDER BY time

panels.title: Protocol Split (SSH vs Telnet)
panels.description: Distribution of Cowrie eventid types over the range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT extract(Body, '(ssh_in|telnet_in)') AS proto, count() AS connections
FROM default.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(TimestampTime)
  AND LogAttributes['namespace'] = 'honeypot' AND LogAttributes['container'] = 'haproxy' AND extract(Body, '(ssh_in|telnet_in)') != ''
GROUP BY proto ORDER BY connections DESC

panels.title: Connections Over Time (SSH vs Telnet)
panels.description: Rate of new honeypot sessions (cowrie.session.connect).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(TimestampTime) AS time, extract(Body, '(ssh_in|telnet_in)') AS proto, count() AS connections
FROM default.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(TimestampTime)
  AND LogAttributes['namespace'] = 'honeypot' AND LogAttributes['container'] = 'haproxy' AND extract(Body, '(ssh_in|telnet_in)') != ''
GROUP BY time, proto ORDER BY time

panels.title: Captured Commands (live)
panels.description: Every command an attacker typed into the honeypot shell (cowrie.command.input). Expand a line to see src_ip, session, username and the full input. This is the primary command-capture feed.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TimestampTime AS timestamp,
  concat(JSONExtractString(Body,'src_ip'), '  [', JSONExtractString(Body,'session'), ']  $ ',
         JSONExtractString(Body,'input')) AS body,
  'info' AS level
FROM default.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(TimestampTime)
  AND LogAttributes['namespace'] = 'honeypot' AND LogAttributes['container'] = 'logship' AND JSONExtractString(Body, 'eventid') = 'cowrie.command.input'
ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 500

panels.title: Login Attempts (success vs failed)
panels.description: Rate of successful vs failed SSH logins captured by the honeypot.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(TimestampTime) AS time,
  countIf(JSONExtractString(Body, 'eventid') = 'cowrie.login.success') AS success,
  countIf(JSONExtractString(Body, 'eventid') = 'cowrie.login.failed')  AS failed
FROM default.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(TimestampTime)
  AND LogAttributes['namespace'] = 'honeypot' AND LogAttributes['container'] = 'logship'
  AND JSONExtractString(Body, 'eventid') IN ('cowrie.login.success','cowrie.login.failed')
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Sessions Over Time
panels.description: Rate of new honeypot sessions (cowrie.session.connect).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(TimestampTime) AS time, count() AS sessions
FROM default.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(TimestampTime)
  AND LogAttributes['namespace'] = 'honeypot' AND LogAttributes['container'] = 'logship' AND JSONExtractString(Body, 'eventid') = 'cowrie.session.connect'
  AND JSONExtractString(Body,'src_ip') != ''
  AND NOT match(JSONExtractString(Body,'src_ip'), '^10\\.244\\.')
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Top Commands
panels.description: Most frequently executed commands captured from interactive sessions (cowrie.command.input).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT JSONExtractString(Body,'input') AS Command, count() AS Times,
  uniqExact(JSONExtractString(Body,'src_ip')) AS "Source IPs"
FROM default.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(TimestampTime)
  AND LogAttributes['namespace'] = 'honeypot' AND LogAttributes['container'] = 'logship' AND JSONExtractString(Body, 'eventid') = 'cowrie.command.input'
  AND JSONExtractString(Body,'input') != ''
GROUP BY Command ORDER BY Times DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Captured Credentials (successful logins)
panels.description: username / password pairs that resulted in cowrie.login.success — the credential combinations attackers believe are valid.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT JSONExtractString(Body,'username') AS Username,
  JSONExtractString(Body,'password') AS Password, count() AS Times
FROM default.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(TimestampTime)
  AND LogAttributes['namespace'] = 'honeypot' AND LogAttributes['container'] = 'logship' AND JSONExtractString(Body, 'eventid') = 'cowrie.login.success'
GROUP BY Username, Password ORDER BY Times DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Event Breakdown
panels.description: Distribution of Cowrie eventid types over the range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT JSONExtractString(Body, 'eventid') AS eventid, count() AS events
FROM default.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(TimestampTime)
  AND LogAttributes['namespace'] = 'honeypot' AND LogAttributes['container'] = 'logship' AND JSONExtractString(Body, 'eventid') != ''
GROUP BY eventid ORDER BY events DESC

panels.title: Honeypot-Detection Attempts (24h)
panels.description: Commands that fingerprint the host (CPU/GPU/uptime) - i.e. an attacker checking whether this is a real box. Cowrie currently sees telnet/Mirai-style bots that do NOT fingerprint, so 0 here is an accurate result, not a broken panel. Compare with the beelzebub tier, which sees heavy GPU recon.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count() AS "Recon commands"
FROM default.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(TimestampTime)
  AND LogAttributes['namespace'] = 'honeypot' AND LogAttributes['container'] = 'logship' AND JSONExtractString(Body, 'eventid') = 'cowrie.command.input'
  AND match(JSONExtractString(Body,'input'), 'uname|lspci|lscpu|nproc|nvidia-smi|ipinfo|/proc/cpuinfo')

panels.title: Distinct Cowrie Source IPs (range)
panels.description: Unique source IPs routed to the cowrie backend. Previously counted ALL haproxy IPs, duplicating "Unique Attacker IPs".

targets.rawSql:
SELECT uniqExactIf(extract(Body, '^([0-9.]+):[0-9]+ '), extract(Body, '^([0-9.]+):[0-9]+ ') != '') AS "Cowrie IPs"
FROM default.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(TimestampTime)
  AND LogAttributes['namespace'] = 'honeypot' AND LogAttributes['container'] = 'haproxy' AND extract(Body, '/(cowrie|beelzebub) ') = 'cowrie'

panels.title: Recon / Detection Commands (live)
panels.description: The actual recon commands attackers run to fingerprint the box.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TimestampTime AS timestamp,
  concat(JSONExtractString(Body,'src_ip'), ' $ ', JSONExtractString(Body,'input')) AS body,
  'warn' AS level
FROM default.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(TimestampTime)
  AND LogAttributes['namespace'] = 'honeypot' AND LogAttributes['container'] = 'logship' AND JSONExtractString(Body, 'eventid') = 'cowrie.command.input'
  AND match(JSONExtractString(Body,'input'), 'uname|lspci|lscpu|nproc|nvidia-smi|ipinfo|/proc/cpuinfo')
ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 300

panels.title: Commands Captured
panels.description: Total cowrie.command.input events over the selected range. These come only from real interactive sessions (not health probes).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count() AS Commands
FROM default.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(TimestampTime)
  AND LogAttributes['namespace'] = 'honeypot' AND LogAttributes['container'] = 'logship' AND JSONExtractString(Body, 'eventid') = 'cowrie.command.input'

panels.title: Sessions
panels.description: Total cowrie.session.connect events over the selected range.

targets.rawSql:

  AND LogAttributes['namespace'] = 'honeypot' AND LogAttributes['container'] = 'logship' AND JSONExtractString(Body, 'eventid') = 'cowrie.session.connect'

panels.title: Failed Logins

panels.title: [beelzebub] Captured Commands (live)
panels.description: Every command an attacker typed into the honeypot shell (cowrie.command.input). Expand a line to see src_ip, session, username and the full input. This is the primary command-capture feed.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TimestampTime AS timestamp,
  concat(JSONExtractString(Body, 'event', 'SourceIp'), '  [', JSONExtractString(Body, 'event', 'ID'), ']  $ ',
         JSONExtractString(Body, 'event', 'Command')) AS body,
  'info' AS level
FROM default.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(TimestampTime)
  AND LogAttributes['namespace'] = 'honeypot' AND LogAttributes['container'] = 'beelzebub' AND JSONExtractString(Body, 'event', 'Msg') = 'SSH Raw Command'
ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 500

panels.title: [beelzebub] Login Attempts vs Terminal Sessions
panels.description: Beelzebub emits no success/failed distinction - every login event is Msg="New SSH Login Attempt" with Status="Stateless". The old panel ran the SAME query twice and labelled them success/failed. Now compares attempts against sessions that actually reached a terminal.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(TimestampTime) AS time,
  countIf(JSONExtractString(Body, 'event', 'Msg') = 'New SSH Login Attempt')    AS login_attempts,
  countIf(JSONExtractString(Body, 'event', 'Msg') = 'New SSH Terminal Session') AS terminal_sessions
FROM default.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(TimestampTime)
  AND LogAttributes['namespace'] = 'honeypot' AND LogAttributes['container'] = 'beelzebub'
  AND JSONExtractString(Body, 'event', 'Msg') IN ('New SSH Login Attempt','New SSH Terminal Session')
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: [beelzebub] Sessions Over Time
panels.description: Uses Msg="New SSH Terminal Session". The old query filtered event_SourceIp!~"10.244..*", which excluded 100% of rows because beelzebub only ever sees haproxy pod IP (no PROXY protocol).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(TimestampTime) AS time, count() AS sessions
FROM default.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(TimestampTime)
  AND LogAttributes['namespace'] = 'honeypot' AND LogAttributes['container'] = 'beelzebub' AND JSONExtractString(Body, 'event', 'Msg') = 'New SSH Terminal Session'
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: [beelzebub] Top Commands
panels.description: Most frequently executed commands captured from interactive sessions (cowrie.command.input).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT JSONExtractString(Body, 'event', 'Command') AS Command, count() AS Times,
  uniqExact(JSONExtractString(Body, 'event', 'SourceIp')) AS "Source IPs"
FROM default.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(TimestampTime)
  AND LogAttributes['namespace'] = 'honeypot' AND LogAttributes['container'] = 'beelzebub' AND JSONExtractString(Body, 'event', 'Msg') = 'SSH Raw Command'
  AND JSONExtractString(Body, 'event', 'Command') != ''
GROUP BY Command ORDER BY Times DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: [beelzebub] Captured Credentials
panels.description: Username+password pairs tried against the beelzebub SSH tier. The old Loki version of this panel needed max_query_series raised to ~5000 and still errored with "maximum of series reached" as the range grew -- credential-stuffing is inherently high-cardinality (491 distinct pairs at 2h, 837 distinct passwords at 24h). The ClickHouse query aggregates server-side with an explicit LIMIT, so there is no series ceiling to outgrow.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT JSONExtractString(Body, 'event', 'User') AS Username,
  JSONExtractString(Body, 'event', 'Password') AS Password, count() AS Times
FROM default.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(TimestampTime)
  AND LogAttributes['namespace'] = 'honeypot' AND LogAttributes['container'] = 'beelzebub' AND JSONExtractString(Body, 'event', 'Msg') = 'New SSH Login Attempt'
GROUP BY Username, Password ORDER BY Times DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: [beelzebub] Event Breakdown
panels.description: Was filtering eventid!="" (a COWRIE field) with no container filter, so it displayed COWRIE events under a beelzebub heading.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT JSONExtractString(Body, 'event', 'Msg') AS event, count() AS events
FROM default.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(TimestampTime)
  AND LogAttributes['namespace'] = 'honeypot' AND LogAttributes['container'] = 'beelzebub' AND JSONExtractString(Body, 'event', 'Msg') != ''
GROUP BY event ORDER BY events DESC

panels.title: [beelzebub] Honeypot-Detection Attempts (24h)
panels.description: GPU/CPU fingerprinting commands (uname, lspci, lscpu, nproc, nvidia-smi, ipinfo.io). Old sentinels matched 0 lines anywhere.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count() AS "Recon commands"
FROM default.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(TimestampTime)
  AND LogAttributes['namespace'] = 'honeypot' AND LogAttributes['container'] = 'beelzebub' AND JSONExtractString(Body, 'event', 'Msg') = 'SSH Raw Command'
  AND match(JSONExtractString(Body, 'event', 'Command'), 'uname|lspci|lscpu|nproc|nvidia-smi|ipinfo|/proc/cpuinfo')

targets.rawSql:

FROM default.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(TimestampTime)

panels.description: Old query filtered event_SourceIp!~"10.244..*" which excluded everything (beelzebub only sees haproxy pod IP).

targets.rawSql:

panels.title: [beelzebub] Terminal Sessions
panels.description: Renamed: the old "Failed Logins" ran the same query as Login Attempts. Beelzebub has no failure signal; this now counts sessions that reached a terminal.

targets.rawSql:

FROM default.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(TimestampTime)
  AND LogAttributes['namespace'] = 'honeypot' AND LogAttributes['container'] = 'beelzebub' AND JSONExtractString(Body, 'event', 'Msg') = 'New SSH Terminal Session'

panels.title: Falco runtime tripwire (breach = attacker escaped the emulation)
HONEYPOT BREACH (Falco) — UNEXPLAINED execs (canary filtered out)
panels.description:
Every Honeypot Container Breach event EXCEPT the tripwire canary's own marker.

The canary (falco/falco-tripwire-canary, `41 */6 * * *`) execs `getent passwd falco-tripwire-canary` into cowrie 4x/day to prove this rule still fires. That marker is filtered here, so anything showing up is an exec nobody has accounted for -- an operator with kubectl, or an intruder.

KNOWN BASELINE, ~4/day: each canary run ALSO emits one `6 init` (the runc plumbing of the exec itself), which carries no marker and cannot be filtered. Those are expected. Anything else is not.

DO NOT suppress `6 init` to clean this up. python3, sh and busybox are all in honeypot_expected_procs, so an exec using them produces NO alert on the command -- the runc plumbing is the only thing that fires. Measured 2026-09-19: six operator execs produced six `6 init` events and zero python3 events. Suppressing it blinds the rule to exactly the binaries an intruder would choose.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TimestampTime AS timestamp,
  JSONExtractString(Body,'output') AS body,
  JSONExtractString(Body,'priority') AS level
FROM default.otel_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimestampTime)
  AND LogAttributes['namespace'] = 'falco' AND LogAttributes['container'] = 'falco'
  AND JSONExtractString(Body,'rule') LIKE 'Honeypot Container Breach%'
  AND Body NOT ILIKE '%falco-tripwire-canary%'
ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 300
